name: Plains/Savannah
body:
Note: It is extremely hard to be surprised in the open plains due to the long distances of openness. Encounters with monsters in the open plains will likely be seen coming a long way off or they might be able to creep up at night.

Description: The following events are applicable if the PC’s are traveling in generally open, relatively flat terrain with only occasional scattered trees or small clusters of trees or foliage.

Recommended Frequency: One time every two hours, whenever PC’s travel more than 10 minutes, or whenever the GM desires.

Weather or Terrain Event

As always, if a particular roll does not make sense or apply in your scenario, reroll or choose a better or more interesting one.
